cases.prompt: Use Wayfinder to create a decision map for this long-running ambiguous initiative. I can name the destination, but most of the route is still fog of war.
Resume this Wayfinder map, claim one ticket from the frontier, resolve it, update the fog and decisions, then stop.
Our multi-session decision map changed after new vendor research. Replan dynamically by graduating only the newly sharp questions from fog and recomputing the frontier.
The decisions are settled. Write an agreed requirements specification with acceptance criteria, non-goals, interfaces, security, and open questions.
Here is the approved specification. Break it into ordered implementation tasks with dependencies, file ownership, acceptance criteria, and verification commands.
Run four implementation agents in parallel git worktrees, assign non-overlapping files, merge their branches, and verify the integrated change.
Create a feature branch, commit these changes, rebase onto main, push it, and open a pull request.
Record this accepted architecture decision in the repository's .shadow graph, link its code evidence, and check for drift.
